data.title: ‘Talk With The Anutin Cabinet’ to air every Saturday
data.description: The government will launch a new weekly programme, “ Talk With The Anutin Cabinet ”, on Saturday, giving ministers a platform to explain their policies, work and plans directly to the public.

data.title: Dense positioning of new streetlights spark questions over 9.9m project
data.description: NAKHON PHANOM — A 9.9-million-baht solar streetlight project in Mukdahan has come under scrutiny on social media over concerns that the lights may have been installed too close together. The local mayor defended the project as necessary and beneficial to the community.

data.title: Former rescue volunteer allegedly rams motorcycle carrying ex-girlfriend, killing two
data.description: Two people were killed after a pickup truck allegedly pursued and deliberately rammed a motorcycle carrying a woman and her new partner in Bangkok early on Thursday, police said.

data.title: 40 Thai officials to study Chinese in Beijing
data.description: Forty Thai government officials will spend a year in Beijing studying Mandarin and experiencing Chinese society and culture under aprogrammeaimed at strengthening people-to-people ties between Thailand and China.

data.title: Volleyball heroines get B14.7m
data.description: <p>The government awarded Thailand's women's volleyball team 14.7 million baht on Thursday after the team captured the Asian title and qualified for the 2028 Olympic Games, while pledging continued support for their Olympic campaign.</p>

data.title: Man arrested over theft of B25,000 on Bangkok to Hong Kong flight
data.description: Hong Kong police have arrested a man on suspicion of stealing nearly 25,000 baht in foreign currency while flying to the city from Thailand, with a passenger allegedly capturing the incident on camera and reporting it to cabin crew.

data.title: Doctor faces probe over 'low class' jibe
data.description: <p>A Bangkok doctor accused of threatening a kidney patient and describing beneficiaries of the 30-baht universal healthcare scheme as "low-class people" faces an investigation by the Ministry of Public Health.</p>

data.title: Sondhi planning street mobilisation
data.description: <p>Political tensions are mounting as veteran protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul prepares to announce a street mobilisation campaign, prompting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to warn that demonstrations must follow the law.</p>

data.title: Parit queried on sources of leaked report
data.description: <p>People's Party MP Parit Wacharasindhu was questioned on Thursday by a House committee on police affairs about the sources of information he cited in allegations of collusion in the Senate election.</p>

data.title: 'Fake father' scheme poses security risk, panel warns
data.description: <p>The House Committee on Public Health has urged authorities to step up investigations into "fake father" networks, warning that foreigners fraudulently registered as Thai could eventually gain the right to own property and enter politics.</p>

data.title: BMA stepping  up checks on  Chabad houses
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up inspections of Chabad house facilities in Bangkok amid concerns over their expansion in areas popular with Israeli tourists and foreign residents.</p>

data.title: Australia eyes drug production potential
data.description: <p>Australia is exploring Thailand as a potential manufacturing base and regional hub for complementary medicines, as Australian businesses seek to expand investment and long-term cooperation.</p>

data.title: Court talks address online crime
data.description: <p>The Criminal Court has brought together police, banks, the media and the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) to discuss ways to tackle online crime, which the court says now accounts for over half of its cases.</p>

data.title: Call-centre scams cost retirees billions
data.description: <p>Cyber police have warned retirees and older people about call-centre scams after losses among victims aged 60 and above reached 3.15 billion baht in eight months.</p>

data.title: Parliament  rejects air bill changes
data.description: <p>The House of Representatives has rejected Senate amendments to the Clean Air Management Bill, voting instead to set up a joint committee to reconsider changes that MPs say would weaken pollution controls.</p>

data.title: Thai lawmaker gets messages of support from Myanmar citizens after protest
data.description: A Thai opposition lawmaker who drew wide attention for disrupting his country's official welcome of Myanmar military chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing last month said he received many messages from Myanmar citizens supporting his action, which he said was meant as a protest against military rule.

data.title: Three hurt in explosion at Samut Prakan factory
data.description: Three workers were injured when a machine exploded inside a car-seat factory in Bang Bo district of Samut Prakan province on Thursday afternoon.

data.title: US sailors on leave begin exploring Pattaya
data.description: PATTAYA - Hordes of US sailors were up early on Thursday as they set out to explore this tourist city on their second day of shore leave.

data.title: Bangkok brings more homeless into system but many decline help
data.description: A new campaign to tackle homelessness in Bangkok has brought some people into the system but a majority are declining help, according to Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA).

data.title: Missing woman’s family fears harm from boyfriend
data.description: CHANTHABURI - The family of a woman missing for nearly a week has appealed to the public for help, after her boyfriend denied seeing her despite CCTV footage showing him picking her on the day she was last seen.

data.title: Red-whiskered bulbul added to no-hunting list
data.description: National parks officials have stepped up efforts to protect the red-whiskered bulbul by adding the species to the list of wildlife that may not be hunted in 40 additional no-hunting areas in Thailand.

data.title: Kamphaeng Phet school shooter faces several charges
data.description: The teenage student who fired multiple shots at his school in Kamphaeng Phet province faces several charges while the school is closed for two days for safety revisions.

data.title: Bangkok data centre cited for unlawful fuel storage
data.description: About 200,000 litres of fuel stockpiled without permission have been removed from a data centre on Rama IX Road in Bangkok, with authorities saying they will pursue charges under Fuel Control Act.

data.title: Thailand’s ‘Jurassic Park’ shines light on dinosaur evolution
data.description: KHON KAEN - A dinosaur statue stands guard outside a temple, a hint at the ancient giants buried deep in the earth below making up northeastern Thailand’s “dinosaur rush”.

data.title: 1,520 electric buses set for rollout
data.description: The Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA) is preparing 1,520 electric buses to replace ageing vehicles, with deliveries expected to begin in March 2027.

data.title: 151 arrested in e-cigarette blitz
data.description: Cyber police arrested 151 suspects and seized more than 140 million baht over the past year in a crackdown on illegal e-cigarette networks.

data.title: Police seize fake memory cards
data.description: PATHUM THANI: Police have seized 16,245 counterfeit memory cards after complaints that fake products sold online caused severe damage to customers' data and computer systems.

data.title: BMA targets protection of mature trees
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up efforts to expand and protect the capital's green spaces by introducing a "heritage tree" designation for valuable mature trees.</p>

data.title: Data gap clouds fate of wild bears
data.description: <p>A lack of reliable data on Thailand's wild bears is hampering efforts to track population declines and protect the animals as threats to their survival intensify.</p>

data.title: DSI serves summons on PP's Somchart
data.description: <p>The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has successfully served a summons on People's Party (PP) MP for Phuket Somchart Techathavorncharoen, ordering him to give a statement next Monday in connection with an investigation into suspected nominee arrangements involving property companies in Phuket.</p>

data.title: Fire-damaged site sealed for debris clean-up
data.description: <p>Authorities have declared the area surrounding the fire-damaged Khlong Thom Centre building a restricted fire zone as they move in to dismantle debris.</p>
